generalTeardownRule.rule: Keep all 20 s waits. A test's own teardown wait may use the R2 bounded pattern (read-only, own session, <=120 s, production paths only, fail naming H8, value-free elapsed evidence) only if its session idled >=300 s recorded or ended via EXPIRED/natural lease lapse AND a run shows a 20 s timeout that later reaches CONFIRMED. A never-confirming PENDING is a product finding, never a longer wait.
